summary.name: Baserow
summary.one_liner: Baserow is an open-source, no-code platform for building databases, applications, automations and AI agents, offered as cloud or self-hosted, and positioned as an alternative to Airtable.
use_cases: Replacing Airtable with a self-hosted database
Publishing applications and portals on your own domain
Managing team data in a spreadsheet-style interface
summary.what_it_does: Baserow combines a spreadsheet-like interface with relational database structure so teams can organize data without writing code. It includes automations for repetitive workflows, dashboards for visualizing data, and applications and portals that can be published on your own domain. A built-in AI assistant (Kuma) can create databases and workflows from natural language. It is API-first and headless, built with Django, Vue.js and PostgreSQL, and can be installed via Docker, Docker Compose, Helm or several hosting providers.
notable: Open-core: non-premium and non-enterprise features under the MIT License
Built-in Kuma AI assistant that builds databases and workflows from natural language
API-first and headless, with published REST API docs and OpenAPI schema
GDPR, HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II compliance claimed for the platform
caveats: Repository is a GitLab mirror; development has moved to GitHub and merged/closed merge requests were not imported
Premium and enterprise features are not under the MIT License
Cloud hosting is offered at baserow.io; self-hosting requires running the Docker or other install yourself
